content_sections.heading: Dr. PDKV Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Dr. PDKV notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Agriculture (M.Sc. Agri) in GPB / Ag. Biotechnology / Seed Technology / Plant Physiology from recognized University Experience: Desirable: Working experience in conducting research trials of Plant Breeding, with knowledge of MS-word, Power point, Excel, etc. Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC and other exempted categories As per university rules Other conditions: No accommodation will be provided for this post Leave and other benefits as per existing norms of the University Desirable: Working experience in conducting research trials of Plant Breeding Knowledge of MS-word, Power point, Excel, etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual; no claim for regular appointment under Dr. PDKV, Akola Tenure up to 31 March 2027, extendable depending on continuation of project, product testing trials and availability of grant Term co-terminus with the project or earlier based on performance Must join within 7 days from the date of issue of order, else the order is treated as cancelled One month prior notice required to leave before the tenure ends, failing which one month pay or pay for the shortfall will not be drawn Principal Investigator (SRS-Pulses) may terminate without notice if duties are not performed as desired

rows.event: Walk-in Interview (reporting 9.00 to 10.00 am; interview at 10.00 am)

content_sections.heading: How Will Dr. PDKV Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Shortlisting Interview Applications will be scrutinised and candidates short listed Eligible candidates will appear for interview Discretionary powers rest with the selection committee and SRS (Pulses)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled-in application proforma with latest passport size photograph Date of birth proof (original with attested copy) Education qualification certificates, SSC and above (original with attested copies) Reprints of research papers published (if any) Experience certificate, if any No objection certificate (if employed)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application proforma printed with the notice (Walk-in Interview Application Form). Affix a latest passport size photograph on the form. Report at the venue between 9.00 and 10.00 am on 16-11-2026. Submit the filled-in proforma with all essential documents in hard copy at the walk-in interview. Bring original documents with attested copies.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Notification does not mean that the post will necessarily be filled Interview at 10.00 am; reporting time 9.00 to 10.00 am on 16-11-2026

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Personnel.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Dr. PDKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Research Scientist, Pulses Research Centre, Dr. PDKV., Akola.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on the date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC and other exempted categories As per university rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30000 per month fixed.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Agriculture (M.Sc. Agri) in GPB / Ag. Biotechnology / Seed Technology / Plant Physiology from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No accommodation will be provided for this post. Leave and other benefits as per existing norms of the University.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Shortlisting. Interview. Applications will be scrutinised and candidates short listed.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual; no claim for regular appointment under Dr. PDKV, Akola. Tenure up to 31 March 2027, extendable depending on continuation of project, product testing trials and availability of grant. Term co-terminus with the project or earlier based on performance.
